text: Qatar Racing, 'the global horse racing and breeding operation of the QIPCO group', became title sponsor of British Champions Day on 4 August 2026 for the next three years, with individual sponsorship of all seven races, succeeding its parent company QIPCO, whose chairman is HH Sheikh Hamad Al Thani.

source.name: British Champions Day - Qatar Racing to become title sponsor of British Champions Day
source.quote: QATAR RACING will succeed its parent company, QIPCO, as title sponsor of British Champions Day.
